title: Levii Stray - M.I.A.
htmlContent:
The release of Levii Stray latest work, “M.I.A.,” has guaranteed one thing. This man is most undoubtedly to stay in the music industry. He’s full of vibrant energy and is a pioneer. He represents all the young artists grinding to make a name for themselves. 

He has assembled his skills in all his years in the industry. And every time he starts creating new music, he makes sure to put all of his efforts into making it a hit. The latest single, “M.I.A.,” has shot Levii Stray career into the atmosphere. The single continues gaining traction and keeps his name in discussions about who will rule the airwaves for 2022.

Levii Stray’s “M.I.A.” is now available on all streaming platforms.
